summary: Tom Clancy's EndWar entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Tom Clancy's EndWar
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with microphone/voice-command and online state documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC or original console hardware if testing microphone behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release with documented voice-command setup

primary.version: PC release with voice-command and online-state caveats documented
primary.why: EndWar's signature feature is voice-command real-time tactics. The PC route is the best capture route, but voice recognition, headset/microphone setup, network services, and platform-specific control behavior must be recorded.
primary.how_to_play: Use the PC release. Record source, patch, OS, microphone/headset, voice-command language/accent behavior, graphics settings, controller/keyboard route, solo campaign state, and whether PS3/Xbox 360/handheld versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting console microphone or controller behavior.
secondary.why: PC is the best capture route, but console voice implementation is part of the original identity.

secondary.what_to_play: Document separately if covering handheld versions.
secondary.why: They are not equivalent to the PC/HD console tactics route.

all_releases.fidelity: HD/PC real-time tactics route with voice-command support.
all_releases.reason: primary: PC for capture, console if validating voice-control behavior.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Voice-command hardware/setup and online-service state are central to how complete an EndWar archive run is.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record voice recognition setup carefully; command input method changes the experience.
